card.name: Small words inside dosing instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (a, the, with, to, that) and word pieces in brand-name drug dosing and restart instructions, just before the next dose, tablet or regimen is named.

modes.label: Linking words before dose terms
modes.description: Short words like a, the, an, with or to that come right before a dose, tablet or schedule in missed-dose or repeat instructions.
modes.example: the scan can be repeated with<< a>> new dose of XENOVIEW.

modes.label: Inside brand names
modes.description: Partway through an uppercase brand or drug name such as NEXPLANON or KIMYRSA's companion product.

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in label instructions about repeating, restarting or missing a dose, and sometimes inside brand names.
